names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 13710, «Иоанн (Чернов), мч.», with the rank word left off. The day’s own line declines the forename and prints no surname at all, «Мч. Иоанна (1939)».

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line with: «Мч. Иоанна (1939)». It is the only year either page gives.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 марта ст. ст. — «Мч. Иоанна (1939)»

attestations.note: The calendar’s line is all there is: no life page on the day page and none on name page 13710, and no place, no diocese, no arrest and no manner of death. He is a martyr and not a monastic martyr and carries no office — the calendar gives him no monastic grade and no rank in the clergy, which is how it prints a layman. «26 января (Новомуч.)» on his name page is what `new-martyr` stands on. azbyka.ru was not read.
